item.title: Help, I Need Somebody
item.description: It’s ok to ask for help. I’ll say it again, it’s ok to ask for help for ANYTHING. Whether it’s advice for your next career step, therapy to help you get out of a loop you’re stuck in or help with doing the laundry, it’s ok to not be 1000% at all times and to sometimes need help.

item.title: Hurry Up & Wait
item.description: Whether you’re just graduating college or years into your career, you’ve probably been told to be patient. That your next opportunity or job is out there, you just have to wait for it. What does it mean to be patient in your career?

item.title: Let Go of the Mean Girls
item.description: Whether you’re in school or in the workplace as an adult, there is always going to be someone who is mean. Learning to coexist and work with this person can be the secret sauce you need to succeed. Here’s how to do it.

item.title: Watch Me: Overcoming Doubt At Work to Achieve Your Goals
item.description: Like many of you, I have a fire in my belly to achieve my goals. I’m driven to keep learning, growing and getting better. I find that the more you push for achievement, the more adversity rears its head in personal doubt and doubt around you. Here’s how to take that doubt and use it to fuel your fire.

item.title: Lifetime Warranty For Your Career
item.description: Lots of products offer a warranty or a lifetime warranty. Wouldn’t it be nice if we could have the same thing for our careers? You know, a lifetime warranty that things will turn out ok? While we don’t get a guarantee, there are steps you can take to make sure that your career path is successful and be confident that things will work out.

item.title: My Top 10 Takeaways from UPW 2020
item.description: Over 4 days, 14 hours a day, I had the exceptional opportunity to learn from Tony Robbins and other speakers at the Unleash Your Power Conference (UPW). They taught tools for psychology, physiology and how to break limiting beliefs to achieve goals with exceptional and genuine energy. Here are my top 10 takeaways.

item.title: Five Tell-Tale Signs Of Workplace Anxiety And What You Can Do About It
item.description: We can be anxious about so many things in our lives. We get nervous for new things, for situations that are uncertain, for change. But our nervous intuition can also help tell us when something isn’t quite right. Here’s how to identify and understand what these emotions are telling you.

item.title: Top Quotes and Takeaways From The Moment Of Lift
item.description: Melinda Gates writes an incredibly poignant and heartfelt book about how empowering women changes the world in The Moment of Lift. Because so many of her examples felt so real to me after travelling the world for work myself, I wanted to share with you some of my takeaways from this great read.

item.title: 7 Self-Care Hacks to Create an Effective and Fulfilled Life
item.description: Every highly effective individual needs an effective self-care routine. Otherwise, being highly effective gets harder and harder until, eventually, burnout sets in. Here’s my “secret sauce” for weekly self-care which allows me to show up confidently and with a zest for life.

item.title: Building Confidence by Trusting in What You Know
item.description: It’s ok to not know everything, but what you do know is where you’ll start in solving any problem. You have to trust in what you know as a leader. But what you know isn’t only facts and data, it’s also your gut reaction and your ability to silence self-doubt.
